subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: How should #88204 be split and owned across core TUI/session state, external WeChat routing, and background event isolation?
rationale: The remaining work crosses plugin ownership, session persistence semantics, channel delivery, and product choices about default session behavior; automation cannot safely choose those boundaries.

options.title: Split into focused canonical issues
options.body: Keep this open as an umbrella until the unresolved TUI, WeChat, flood, and activity-timestamp tracks each have a clear owner and acceptance criteria.

options.title: Keep one manual umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as the sole tracking item, but block automated repair until a maintainer writes the intended product boundary and live repro requirements.

options.title: Close after linking existing work
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide #51028 and the open sessions_send/WeChat routing items fully cover the remaining user impact.

recommendation.title: Split into focused canonical issues
recommendation.body: Keep this open as an umbrella until the unresolved TUI, WeChat, flood, and activity-timestamp tracks each have a clear owner and acceptance criteria.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved pieces need core session/TUI triage before the WeChat plugin owner can safely take the channel-specific portion.
